warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender D240 Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Defender D240 has the Ingenium AJ200D diesel — that's every D240 ever built, since it was only produced during 2019–2020 — the Ingenium timing chain pattern is a known consideration on this engine family. We inspect and replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

include_in_hero_hook: yes for AJ200D — Source: established specialist pattern, per VRF-landrover-defender.md. Note: one forum source specifically claims the D240 does NOT share the oil-dilution issue affecting other Ingenium diesels — this is flagged for awareness only and not stated as fact on the page.
